package.name: biped_hw
package.description: Cable-driven biped hardware: compile-time 12-motor map, USB-CAN adapter, Damiao MIT + Motorevo HA60 codec. P1: p1_dm_communicate / p1_evo_communicate (CAN ID is kCanId in the source). P2: p2_dm_test / p2_evo_test. P3 dual-bus: p3_dual_knee_spin (left CAN 6 ACM0 + right CAN 9 ACM1 Damiao MIT slow ramp). MBS magnetic encoder RS485 poll: mbs_encoder_recv (USB-RS485 by-id, not ttyUSB0). P4 RobotState dump: p4_state_dump (listen-only or --enable-knees 6+12 hold + MBS + /imu latch). Hip parallel FK/IK: hip_parallel_kin + p4_hip_kin_self_test (no hardware). P6 getState/sendCommand + quintic_traj: p6_traj_track (quintic about probe q0; default right 9-14; --self-test).
